traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.summary: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, drop to 1 hit point instead, once per long rest.

traits.name: Tempered Strength
traits.summary: Once per short or long rest, extra PB damage on a melee weapon hit, or 2 × PB if you are below half hit points.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.summary: Count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Desert Adaptation
traits.summary: Acclimated to extreme heat and freezing nights; five days without drinking before thirst exhaustion; ignore difficult terrain from sand, dust, and loose rock.
traits.noEffect: Climate, thirst, and desert terrain kinds are not simulated yet.

traits.name: Mirage Runner
traits.summary: Ignore difficult terrain when you Dash through sand or open desert, and leave no tracks on sand or dust.
traits.noEffect: Desert Dash terrain is not simulated yet.

traits.name: Horizon Sense
traits.summary: After 1 minute observing open terrain, know cardinal directions, hours until nightfall, and whether a sandstorm is likely; cannot become lost in desert, steppe, or badland except by magic.

traits.name: Forest Camouflage
traits.summary: In forest terrain, hide even when only lightly obscured by foliage.
traits.noEffect: Forest concealment is not a grid layer yet.

traits.name: Tracker's Sense
traits.summary: Track creatures that passed through an area up to 7 days ago, and identify approximate size and direction of travel.

traits.name: Eyes of the Deep Veldt
traits.summary: While in bright light such as direct sunlight, disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Sentinel's Eye
traits.summary: When you observe a group of creatures from afar, accurately judge its distance, numbers, and direction of travel.
traits.noEffect: Long-range group appraisal is not simulated.

traits.name: Tower Code
traits.summary: Send and understand simple horn-and-banner messages to anyone in line of sight who knows the code, no matter the distance.

traits.name: Built to Last
traits.summary: With a glance, tell whether a structure is sound, sabotaged, or recently altered; 10 minutes reinforcing a structure gives foes disadvantage to break it.
traits.noEffect: Structures and barricades are not simulated yet.
